registered_before: the merged LID-DS 2021 v2 output exists (3 scenarios still running), and before any LID-DS 2019 result of any arm is read
seen_before_registration: pooled official v2 results of 12/15 LID-DS 2021 scenarios per arm (recall / false-alarm recordings: system 71.9/3.1, step1 72.3/4.9, path 62.5/1.4, errno 61.1/1.4, bytes 83.2/3.7, step2 97.2/9.5, ngram 84.4/0.9, step3 97.3/10.0) and per-scenario rows; CB-DS confirmation results of every v2 arm. Declared: v3 is designed after these were read
owner_decision: 31/10, supervisor's workflow: improve on the datasets until precision and recall reach >= 95 %, then go live
question: Can a fixed combination rule over the v2 branches keep recall >= 95 % while bringing false-alarm recordings back to <= 3.0 % on LID-DS 2021?

candidates.C0_step3: every v2 branch ORed (the v2 system, reference)
candidates.C1_union_core: system OR path OR errno OR bytes OR ngram (step3 without the support-first and no-exec-set variants)
candidates.C2_vote2_core: at least 2 of {system, path, errno, bytes, ngram}
candidates.C3_system_or_vote2: system OR at least 2 of {path, errno, bytes, ngram}
candidates.C5_vote2_all: at least 2 of {ml, tripwire, path, errno, bytes, ngram}

combination_level: per recording, from the stored per-recording outcome of each branch (recordings in the v2 output): an attack recording is detected by a vote rule when at least k branches detected it after the exploit, with the k-th smallest latency; a normal recording is a false alarm when at least k branches alarmed in it; k = 1 is OR. Window-level voting is not computed (not stored); stated as a limitation
split: development = the v2 development attack recordings (30 %, seed 20261030 + crc32(scenario)) plus 30 % of each scenario's test/normal recordings (names sorted, numpy default_rng(20261031 + crc32(scenario)) permutation, first round(0.3 n)); official = the other 70 % of both
selection: on LID-DS 2021 development only: the candidate with the highest pooled development recall among those with development false-alarm recordings <= 2.0 %; ties by lower false-alarm rate, then by list order; if none qualifies, the one with the lowest false-alarm rate among those with recall >= 95 %, and v3 is reported as not reaching its goal

criteria_official.H1: selected candidate on LID-DS 2021 official: pooled recall >= 95 % AND false-alarm recordings <= 3.0 %
criteria_official.H2: and no scenario above 5 % false-alarm recordings
criteria_official.precision: reported at 1:1 (attack:normal recordings) and at the subset's own base rate

confirmation: the selected candidate unchanged on LID-DS 2019 (lidds2019-confirmation-v1 outputs, read only after this registration) and on CB-DS (seen for v2, so a sensitivity check only); every candidate is reported on every dataset
code: scripts/analysis/lidds_v3_combine.py (tests/test_lidds_v3_combine.py), reading lidds_evaluate_v2.py outputs; no branch is recomputed
next_if_met: only if H1 holds on 2021 official and the selected rule reaches recall >= 95 % at <= 3.0 % false alarms on LID-DS 2019: port the selected branches into the probe and user space (exec-intent-v1 P2/P3 path) for a live blind run
